purpose: Evidence, freshness and model-boundary controls for market, fund and issuer research systems.
requirements: Every material market, fund or issuer fact preserves a source identity and the observation, publication or document date available for that fact.
Retrieval time is not substituted for observation or publication time.
Missing, stale, rejected or unavailable evidence remains explicit and is not silently repaired, zero-filled or represented as current.
Numerical values are accepted only with validated identity, unit and finite-value checks appropriate to the series.
Calculations preserve their input identities, dates, units and formula and are distinguished from publisher-reported facts.
Comparisons that require matched periods or observation dates fail closed when the required inputs are not comparable.
Historical evidence is labelled as historical and does not silently become a current market or issuer claim.
Fund and security identity is resolved explicitly; ambiguous records do not inherit facts from similarly named products or issuers.
Model prompts treat retrieved research as evidence/data, preserve supplied provenance and limitations, and do not treat prior model output as source authority.
Provider/model storage is disabled when supported for private research interactions, and model failures are not presented as completed research.
Research output distinguishes source facts, application calculations and analytical interpretation.
Authentication, authorisation and private research records remain server-side and privileged database credentials are not exposed to clients or model output.
When source provenance, identity, freshness or required evidence cannot be established, the affected conclusion is narrowed or withheld rather than invented.
nonClaims: This policy does not guarantee investment performance or market forecasts.
This policy does not make historical observations current.
This policy does not convert research into personal financial advice.
This policy does not certify a publisher or external data provider as error-free.
